footer_note: Interactive rendering of the canonical v3 diagram in docs/architecture.md (same folder) — the Mermaid source there is the source of truth, and this rendering is generated from the same model.
header_sub: Drag any box to move it, drag the background to pan, scroll / pinch buttons to zoom, click a box for its details. Dragging explores the view — it does not change the canonical source (docs/architecture.md in this repo).

ci.body: The thin fleet-CI caller on every push: validation, link check, and Lighthouse, all defined once in the shared kit's reusable workflow.
ci.title: CI Workflows

fbstate.body: Which form responses have already been reported, so each one surfaces exactly once.
fbstate.title: Feedback Watch State

fbwatch.body: Hourly: checks the feedback form for new responses and reports each one to Andrew verbatim (daytime hours only).
fbwatch.title: Feedback Watch

gc.body: Privacy-friendly visit counts for the showcase. Kept on this site; deliberately not the fleet standard (domain properties count via Cloudflare instead).
gc.title: GoatCounter

gform.body: The public feedback form linked from the site's Get in touch section. The public email address stays off the site; the form is the inbox.
gform.title: Feedback Form

gt.body: Automatic translation into the visitor's language, detected from the browser. Copyable prompt blocks are marked notranslate so prompts stay verbatim.
gt.title: GTranslate

mirror.body: The same page on the github.io address. Its first script redirects every visit to andrewdhorowitz.com, preserving path, query, and hash.
mirror.title: GitHub Pages Mirror

owner.body: The person the site showcases. Publishes through the assistant and answers feedback.
owner.title: Andrew (owner / author)

page.body: The canonical site at andrewdhorowitz.com (apex + www): project cards, copyable prompts, embedded architecture diagrams, and contact — all in one page.
page.title: Showcase Page

repo.body: andrewdhorowitz.github.io — canonical source: the page, its prompts, the embedded diagram sources, and (on approval) this diagram.
repo.title: Showcase Repo

responses.body: Where submitted feedback lands. Read by the Feedback Watch on its hourly poll.
responses.title: Form Responses

upkeep.body: Builds each update, verifies it live, and pushes through the snapshot route. Under the upkeep rule, a feature change carries its card text, its embedded prompt, and its diagram in the same push.
upkeep.title: Site Builder and Upkeep

visitor.body: Reads the portfolio: project cards, copyable build prompts, automations, architecture diagrams.
visitor.title: Visitor / evaluator

wa.body: Page-level counts for the domain, fed by the beacon script embedded in the page. Installed Oct 29 on the showcase and AIMF only.
wa.title: Web Analytics Beacon

panel_body: One static page, two hosts: Cloudflare Pages serves the canonical site at andrewdhorowitz.com and the GitHub Pages copy is a mirror that redirects to it. Feedback lands in a Google Form that an assistant-side watch polls. Click any box for its job.

muse.sub: Automation runtime, off the web host
muse.title: Muse — assistant side
